original_test_intent: Qualify the approved GPU input EDPp power envelope and prove every subtest passes without exceeding voltage/current/power, VRM/PSU, cooling or platform health limits.
original_method: Verify nvqual provenance/checksum/compatibility and pin EDPp wrapper; define envelope axes, target/limits and duration; baseline input voltage/current/power, power limit, PSU/feed/VRM, fan/ambient/thermal and errors; drain workloads, preserve logs, verify OOB/hard stops; run once with synchronized telemetry, then cool down and verify recovery.
manual_activity: Power/thermal owners approve EDPp envelope, sensor sources and hard stops; operator validates redundant power/cooling/OOB, drains workloads and owns emergency recovery.
required_inputs: Exact nvqual provenance/version/checksum/license and stack match
Maintenance, OOB, hard-stop and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not fabricate envelope targets or artifact
Preserve full output and sensor time series
agent_execution_scope: Run one approved EDPp suite under hard stops
Evaluate every subtest and telemetry excursion
Cool down, restore and report without verdict
